outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially open, with the green dish visible inside (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with the door, then raises it toward the oven front (frames 57–68, image and left_ego_image). The door is upright and closed by frame 70 and remains closed through frame 92 (left_ego_image, corroborated by image and wrist_image). No failed attempt or unintended displacement of surrounding objects is visible.
